bibl.title: From Egypt to Copenhagen. The Provenance of the Portraits of Augustus, Livia, and Tiberius at the Ny Carlsberg Glyptotek.

bibl.note: Introduction. - The acquisition. - [Greek-Egyptian art dealer Alexander] Dingli's letter [to Valdemar Schmidt]. - The bone tesserae [found in the same place where the three portraits where discovered]. - Arsinoe?
